title: FGAO
text: FGAO stands for Feedback-Greedy Agentic Orchestration. It is a training-free controller that chooses the next tool call by predicted progress on verifiable goals, net of cost.

title: FGAO
text: FGAO abstains when no answer is both grounded in a retrieved passage and accepted by a support check.

title: FGAO
text: The FGAO controller learns from the outcomes of its own tool calls during a run, through a prior-and-feedback blend of effect estimates.
